validation.how: Errors render in a 'Needs review' list after all sections (`body.child(section("Needs review", issues, cx))`); only the label turns red, and only when an error key equals an input key (here only email, since amount errors are keyed 'amounts').

findings.now: Each Part V table shows six fixed rows with no Add row control, so a seventh property, share, transfer or business interest cannot be entered.
findings.why: The official tables grow (the layout has two rows per table), and form_1801_view.rs:108-109, form_1801.rs:33 and form_1801.rs:810 plus commit f0ccc302 describe an 'Add row' button that the page never built, so the omission is silent.

options.name: Add row button
options.detail: Append rows on demand and splice them after the last row, as table_rows and official_layout already expect.

options.name: Raise the visible limit
options.detail: Render rows up to the model limit of 20 with a visible row count.

options.name: Warn when full
options.detail: Show a notice when a table is full and the filer must add the rest by hand.

findings.now: The typed e-mail is written in upper case into the uploaded XML and into the Print preview.
findings.why: The email must never be upper-cased, and form_1801.rs:630 applies up() to txtEmail where form_2000.rs:1004 keeps it as typed.

options.name: Write as typed
options.detail: Set txtEmail to the trimmed text the filer typed, as form_2000.rs:1004 does.

options.name: Exclude from the upper-case pass
options.detail: Keep up() for the other text controls and skip txtEmail, matching the documented capital() behaviour.

options.name: Record a reviewed exception
options.detail: If the official HTA really uppercases txtEmail, document it as an exception while the displayed value stays as typed.

findings.now: Item 39 is rounded with JavaScript toFixed(2), so a half-centavo value shows one centavo lower than formatCurrency gives, for example 5.005 shows 5.00 instead of 5.01.
findings.why: formatCurrency rounds floor(x×100 + 0.50000000001) (official_xml.rs:473-482, bir-rules static_ir.rs:4343), so the printed and uploaded amounts can disagree with the official form.

options.name: Use official_amount
options.detail: Round computed money with official_amount, as form_1800.rs does through cents().

options.name: Cite the official line
options.detail: If the HTA calls toFixed(2) on this line, cite that line and keep toFixed for this field only.

options.name: Add half-centavo samples
options.detail: Add sample payloads with values such as 5.005 to lock the rounding rule.

findings.now: Errors for the Item 1 date, the Item 7 name, the Item 8 address and the Item 10 executor leave their labels black, so only the Needs review list shows them.
findings.why: has_error (event_form_kit.rs:154-163) matches only equal keys, and death_date, estate_name, residence_address and administrator_name differ from the input keys month, day, year, name, address and admin_name.

options.name: Map keys to inputs
options.detail: Report each error under its editor key so has_error matches.

options.name: Message beside field
options.detail: Render each message under its own input as well as in the list.

options.name: Focus first error
options.detail: Scroll to and focus the first failing input when Queue or Save is pressed.

findings.now: The TIN is read-only text, but the Needs review line says 'Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 5.'
findings.why: The draft copies the profile TIN at creation (form_1801.rs new_from_profile) and load_draft never refreshes it (queueable_forms.rs:43-47), so a bad TIN blocks Queue with no fix on this page.

options.name: Editable TIN
options.detail: Let the filer correct the TIN on the draft, under the same checksum rule as the profile.

options.name: Refresh from profile
options.detail: Re-read the profile TIN when an editable draft opens.

options.name: Link to profile
options.detail: Replace the alert with a button that opens the taxpayer profile.

findings.now: Commit f0ccc302, a 1801 feature, adds a 74-line extend_layout to the shared official_inputs.rs, and commit df48af19 edits form_1707.rs and form_1707a.rs.
findings.why: Shared modules and other forms may change only for one-line registrations, and these edits add logic that other forms now depend on.

options.name: Move to a 1801-only module
options.detail: Keep extend_layout in form_1801.rs or a 1801-only helper file.

options.name: Split the commits
options.detail: Move the 1707 and 1707A edits into their own commits with their own tests.

options.name: Keep with a note
options.detail: Accept the shared helper and record it as a reviewed shared change.

findings.now: A new 1801 opens Item 1 as 01/01 of the tile's year, a placeholder that is accepted if the filer does not change it.
findings.why: The death date goes into the XML, and validation accepts 1 January as long as it is not in the future.

options.name: Blank until entered
options.detail: Start Item 1 empty and require a valid date before Queue.

options.name: Visible placeholder
options.detail: Keep the default but show it as a placeholder that must be confirmed.

options.name: Confirm notice
options.detail: Show a 'confirm the date of death' line until Item 1 is edited.

findings.now: A clean check shows no 'Validation successful' confirmation because the page has no Validate action.
findings.why: The official alert validate-025 is never shown, so the set of official alerts reproduced is incomplete.

options.name: Show the official success text
options.detail: Display 'Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.' after a clean check.

options.name: Add a Validate action
options.detail: Add a Validate button that runs the check and shows the official success line or the Needs review list.

options.name: Accept the gap
options.detail: Record the missing success line as an accepted difference from the official page.
